Additional Terms and Conditions: Ultrasonography (USG) machine Additional Terms and Conditions: 1. The USG system shall be supplied as a complete functional unit with all probes, software, applicati on packages and accessories required for comprehensive Obstetric and Gynaecological imaging. 2. The quoted configuration shall mandatorily include convex, linear, transvaginal/endocavitary and v olume probe(s) required for 3D/4D imaging. These shall not be quoted as optional accessories. 3. Dedicated OB/GYN application package including fetal biometry, gestational age, estimated fetal w eight, fetal growth assessment, Doppler indices, growth charts and obstetric reporting shall be included. 4. Applications packages including OBSTETRICS + GYNECOLOGY + Doppler + TVS + 3D/4D i s mandatory 5. Comprehensive warranty: Minimum 5 years from the date of successful installation and commis sioning. 6. Comprehensive CAMC for 5 years after expiry of warranty, including preventive maintenance, br eakdown maintenance, labour, service charges and replacement of defective spare parts/components as applicable. 7. Installation, commissioning, calibration, safety testing and demonstration shall be carried out by th e OEM/authorized service provider at no additional cost. Comprehensive hands-on training shall be provided to the doctors and designated technica l staff of the Department of Obstetrics & Gynaecology. Detailed description of the actual use of the equipment The Ultrasonography (USG) machine will be utilized in the Department of Obstetrics & Gynaecology for dia gnostic imaging of obstetric and gynaecological patients in the Out-Patient area. Point-of-care obstetric and gynaecological ultrasonography in the OPD for: viability and dat ing scans, urgent gynaecological scans (suspected ruptured ectopic, torsion, haemorrhage) , pre-operative scans for surgical planning, AFI assessment following a reactive NST, and ba sic obstetric scans for high-risk antenatal patients. It will also be used for hands-on training of postgraduate students in basic OBG ultrasound under supervision. .
